Plans

A plan for where you are.
Room for where you’re going.

Choose the depth your business needs, from everyday invoicing to connected accounting and inventory. Monthly plans start at R190. O-IBS is preparing for early access / closed beta; public paid subscriptions are not open.

Not sure which plan?

Start with the work you do.

No personal information needed. Choose the description closest to your business; this is a starting point to discuss during Early Access.

I mainly sell services, invoice customers and record everyday costs.

Start with Basic — R190/month. It includes quotes, invoices, customer payments and balances, expenses, supported expense receipt capture, simple reports and everyday Bizzy help.

I also manage supplier bills, bank records or fuller bookkeeping.

Consider Business — R450/month. It adds supplier invoices and payments, statements, credit notes and refunds, assets, bank matching and detailed financial reports. Banking uses imported or manually recorded transactions; it does not initiate payments.

I buy, hold and manage products or stock.

Consider Complete — R650/month. It includes Business plus stock quantities and value, purchase orders, goods received, product returns and stock reports with Bizzy inventory help.

No VAT is presently charged. This guide does not select a subscription or guarantee an invitation. Compare the full feature list below.

O-IBS BASIC

Run the essentials

R190/month

For small businesses that need simple sales, expenses and customer management.

  • Keep your customers in one place
  • Create professional quotes and invoices
  • Record customer payments and see customer balances
  • Record and organise business expenses
  • Scan or upload supported expense receipts for extraction and review
  • See simple reports showing how the business is doing
  • Ask Bizzy everyday business questions

O-IBS BUSINESS

Know where your money stands

R450/month

For businesses that also buy from suppliers and need a clearer picture of what they owe, what customers owe them and how the business is performing.

  • Everything in Basic
  • See which customers still owe you money
  • See what you still owe suppliers
  • Customer statements, credit notes and refunds
  • Record supplier invoices and payments
  • Scan or upload supported supplier invoices for extraction and review
  • Keep track of what your business owns (assets)
  • Match bank transactions to your O-IBS records
  • See detailed business and accounting reports, with accounting terms explained in everyday language
  • Bizzy help with bookkeeping and financial records

O-IBS COMPLETE

Run your whole operation

R650/month

For businesses that buy, hold and sell products or stock.

  • Everything in Business
  • Keep track of products and stock quantities
  • Create purchase orders for suppliers
  • Record stock when it arrives
  • See what stock is available, reserved or running low
  • See how much your stock is worth
  • Stock and inventory reports
  • Record products returned by customers
  • Bizzy can help answer questions about your stock
